data.gender_notes: Adamo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew adamah, meaning 'man' or 'earth'. In Genesis, Adam is the first man created by God. The name is also associated with the color red. The name Adamo carries the meaning “Man, Earth, Red” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adamo usually hope their child will grow to embody man, earth, red and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of creation and new beginnings.
data.etymology: Adamo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, Earth, Red.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adamo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אדמו
in_hebrew.meaning: אדם הראשון, האדם שנברא על ידי אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אדמו מקורו בשם העברי אדם, שפירושו אדם הראשון שנברא על ידי אלוהים. השם אדמו הוא צורה הונגרית ו-איטלקית של השם אדם, ומשמש לעתים קרובות כחלופה לשם אדם.

in_greek.name: Αδάμο
in_greek.meaning: Ο πρώτος άνθρωπος που δημιουργήθηκε από τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδάμο προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Αδάμ, που σημαίνει ο πρώτος άνθρωπος που δημιουργήθηκε από τον Θεό. Στην παράδοση Χριστιανική, ο Αδάμ θεωρείται ο πρώτος άνθρωπος και ο πρόγονος της ανθρωπότητας.

in_latin.name: Adamo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adamo derivatum est ex hebraeo nomine Adam, quod significat primus homo a Deo creatus. In traditione Christiana, Adam consideratur primus homo et progenitor humani generis.
